text:
Maya: Quick sync — I ran apples-to-apples bench comparing kernel selection, batching heuristics, and KV cache behavior. Using both synthetic traffic and replay harness. Results look noisy.

Lee: Can you share exact command + decoding params? apples-to-apples means identical prompts + tokenizer + decoding.

Maya: Run:
```
./bench/run.py --model=redwood/llama-13b-q4 --prompts=bench/prompts/long_tail.jsonl \
  --decoding='top_p=0.95,temperature=0.2' --max_new_tokens=256 \
  --stop='\n\n' --tokenizer=sentencepiece --streaming=false 
```
Also used synthetic generator with poisson arrival (lambda=0.5) and a replay harness ingesting prod traces (anonymized).

Arjun: Important: tokenizer alignment — ensure sentencepiece model file identical. Small tokenizer mismatch changes token counts -> different perf and stop-triggering.

Sophie: Quick pprof dump from host-gpu-12:
```
Total: 1200s
kernel_attention_x: 48% (576s)
kernel_fused_mha: 30% (360s)
KV_cache_lookup: 7% (84s)
Batching_idle: 5% (60s)
```
KV cache hit-rate ~72% for replay, ~5% for synthetic cold-start.

Maya: Noticed perf regression when seq_len>512 — fused_mha drops and attention_x takes over with worse latency. Likely kernel selector mispred because of dynamic shapes.

Lee: Synthetic vs replay: synthetic had smaller prefix reuse -> lower KV hit. Replay keeps prefixes so batching+kv caching effects are more pronounced. For apples-to-apples we should run replay but normalize arrival times (remove think-time) so QPS matches synthetic target.

LoadBot: run-82734 completed — artifacts: https://artifacts/internal/82734

Ethan: Proposed checklist for apples-to-apples:
- identical prompts file (sha256)
- identical tokenizer binary (sha256)
- same decoding settings + seed
- streaming toggled same
- same HW config + driver
- record kernel-selection logs

Arjun: I'll run micro-expt toggling kernel selection policy:
```
./bench/run.py --policy=deterministic --override-kernels='fused_mha,attention_x' --runs=30
```

Maya: Let's collate results into a short methodology doc and add a CI gate: any regression >5% p95 latency on canonical prompt set fails.

Sophie: ack :thumbsup:

Lee: tagging infra to ensure driver versions are pinned — @infra-team

Maya: I'll post summary + raw traces in the perf board. Thanks all.
